title: Albert Stein's deathbed call to Sheehan
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Albert Stein's deathbed call to Sheehan, about unspecified at Hospice in northern Minnesota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Albert Stein was this guy's name uh he called me on his deathbed uh he was dying up in in northern Minnesota

plain: Dan Sheehan, a guest on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in an episode about a man said to be involved in many American secrets, says a man named Albert Stein phoned him while dying in a hospice in northern Minnesota. Sheehan tells it as a last-moment contact from someone who wanted to pass something on before he died, though the clip does not say what.
